name: compact-guard
description: PreCompact hook that injects the captured session-intent anchor as a structural hint BEFORE the compaction model sees the context. Survival of the original goal is structurally guaranteed by the hook lifecycle — not left to the compactor's recency bias. Owns engine D1 (LCS for survival-check).
